programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.headline: Emirates Marks 35th Anniversary of Hong Kong Operations
stories.lead: Emirates is celebrating 35 years of service to Hong Kong, a route that began in July 1991 and has grown into a key part of its global network.
stories.source_description: Hong Kong, 21 October 2026: Emirates is commemorating 35 years of serving Hong Kong, building on a remarkable journey that took flight in July 1991. What began with Emirates’ first landing in Hong Kong has evolved into a longstanding relationship with the city, connecting generations of travellers with Dubai and destinations around the world, with its Fly Better promise at the heart of every journey. The journey began with the arrival of flight EK068 at the former Kai Tak Airport, marking Emirates’ debut in Hong Kong and a new chapter in the city’s aviation story. Operated as a thrice-weekly Dubai-Hong Kong-Manila service, the route made Hong Kong Emirates’ 22 nd destination from Dubai and its fourth in the Far East. “For 35 years, Hong Kong has been an important part of Emirates’ history from our first arrival at Kai Tak Airport to the introduction of new aircraft, products and experiences for our passengers. This anniversary allows us to reflect on our shared journey and look ahead towards the future. We remain committed to connecting Hong Kong with the wider world and enhancing the experience at every stage of travel. The sky is the limit,” said Sultan Alriyami, Emirates’ Hong Kong Area Manager. Over the years, Emirates has become a preferred choice for Hong Kong travellers. The airline introduced its flagship A380 service to the city in October 2010, followed by a fourth daily Hong Kong-Dubai flight in October 2013. It opened the Emirates Hong Kong Travel Store in July 2024, its first in East Asia, creating a dedicated local presence for customers. The momentum continued in 2025 with the arrival of Emirates’ latest retrofitted Boeing 777 and A380 cabins, bringing an enhanced onboard experience to travellers departing from Hong Kong. Today, Emirates serves Hong Kong with three daily flights, including two direct services to Dubai and a third daily service via Bangkok. Through Dubai, passengers can connect onwards to more than 138 destinations worldwide, including popular destinations among Hong Kong travellers such as London, Paris and Milan. From October, selected Hong Kong services, including flights EK380/381 and EK382/383, will be operated by the airline's flagship A380 aircraft. Beyond expanding its global network, Emirates continues to focus on details that define each travel experience, from cabin products, dining and entertainment to service on the ground. Emirates’ dedicated lounge, which first opened its doors in 2012, welcomed customers back in March 2024 following an extensive refurbishment. In July 2025, the airline added another significant development when it introduced its world-class Premium Economy products on the Hong Kong route.

stories.headline: Delta Partners Host Innovation Event Featuring JetZero and Joby Aviation
stories.lead: Delta Air Lines, alongside Paramount+ and Delta Sustainable Skies Lab partners, hosted an event showcasing next-generation aircraft concepts and decarbonization initiatives.
stories.source_description: Building on their partnership through Delta Sync, Delta and Paramount+ recently hosted SkyMiles Members for an exclusive experience at JetZero’s Design Center in Long Beach, California. Guests stepped into the world of Star Trek, exploring franchise artifacts and ideas that have inspired generations to dream about the future of flight. From there, guests viewed the aviation technologies taking shape today, including JetZero’s blended wing body aircraft and Joby’s electric air taxi . Select customers also participated in a collaborative innovation workshop alongside the Delta Sustainable Skies Lab partners to explore real-world solutions for aviation decarbonization. The two-day event marked the first time Delta customers were invited inside JetZero’s facility, and heard more about the blended-wing-body aircraft concept, which has the potential to be up to 50% more fuel efficient than today's conventional aircraft designs. Customers also had the opportunity to share feedback on next-generation aircraft concepts designed to advance sustainability while enhancing the customer experience. For 60 years, the Star Trek franchise has invited audiences to look beyond what seems possible and imagine how technology could transform the way people move, communicate and explore. Through Delta’s partnership with Paramount+, that spirit of imagination became the starting point for an immersive journey into the real-world aircraft concepts and technologies Delta and its partners are advancing today. "We launched the Sustainable Skies Lab as an innovation incubator to partner with transformative companies bringing revolutionary technologies to life," said Amelia DeLuca, Chief Sustainability Officer for Delta Air Lines. "Where the future of flight once lived in imagination, today it is taking shape through collaboration and innovation. Working together with partners like JetZero and Joby, we're accelerating breakthrough ideas and giving customers a front-row seat to the work that will redefine travel." “JetZero will deliver the world’s first all-wing airplane, which will be up to 50% more fuel efficient while elevating the customer experience,” said Tom O’Leary, CEO and Co-Founder, JetZero. “Delta Air Lines was our first airline collaborator, which helps ensure the passengers’ voice is heard in the design process as we eliminate major travel friction points. Hearing directly from Delta’s SkyMiles members is invaluable as we approach the Demonstrator’s first flight at the end of 2027.” Delta x Star Trek event selects 2 Bringing the future of flight on board and home To continue celebrating Star Trek’s 60th anniversary, Delta and Paramount+ launched new customer offerings across the travel journey: Six decades of Star Trek at 30,000 feet: Delta customers can explore a curated Star Trekanthology through the airline’s in-flight entertainment, bringing together beloved classics and newer favorites from across the franchise’s 60-year history, all at their seatback screens.” A one-of-a-kind SkyMiles Experience: Members redeemed miles for access to the event through Delta SkyMiles Experiences, connecting them with a passion point and opening the door to an experience made possible by Delta and its partners. Through the Delta Sustainable Skies Lab, Delta continues to build cross-industry relationships that support its short-, medium- and long-term decarbonization goals while keeping customers connected to the ideas and innovations that could shape the future of flight. Delta’s Sustainable Skies Lab partner, Joby Aviation, is developing an electric air taxi that reimagines how customers get to and from airports. Joby already completed demonstration flights across New York City earlier this year.

stories.headline: Emirates Scales Up Flights to Durban for the Festive Season
stories.lead: Emirates is adding 14 flights between Dubai and Durban across December 2026 and January 2027 to meet festive season demand.
stories.source_description: Additional 14 flights across December and January will help passengers connect with friends and family or take an end-of-year trip Dubai, UAE, 20 October 2026 - Emirates is adding 14 flights between Dubai and Durban across December 2026 and January 2027, giving customers more opportunities to travel during the busy festive season. Whether heading home to celebrate with family and friends, escaping the Northern Hemisphere’s winter for South Africa’s balmy summer, or making the most of the year-end break to explore somewhere new, the additional frequencies will offer more choice and connectivity during one of the busiest travel periods of the year. Between 17–23 December 2026 and 2–8 January 2027, Emirates will operate a second daily flight between Dubai and Durban, using a three-class Boeing 777. Flight EK2535 will depart Dubai at 04:00 hrs, landing in Durban at 10:30 hrs; the return flight, EK2536 will take off from Durban at 12:15 hrs and land in Dubai at 22:30 hrs. EK775 and EK776, the existing daily service, will continue to operate as scheduled. The additional flights will also offer Durban residents more opportunities to explore the world over the festive season. Via Emirates’ hub in Dubai, customers can connect to over 140 destinations on its global network, making it easier to plan holidays and discover new locations before ringing in 2027. The most popular December destinations with Durbanites include Dubai, Thailand, Indonesia, India, France and the UK, all of which benefit from seamless connections with the additional services. With a full programme of festivals and gigs, beachfront fireworks, cultural and heritage experiences, and exquisite dining options, Durban is at its best in summer. In fact, 1.2 million visitors travelled to the city across the festive period alone, last year. Emirates’ additional flights will support the city’s inbound tourism ambitions, creating more opportunities for international visitors to experience Durban’s unique and vibrant summer offering, particularly from destinations supported by the introduction of South Africa’s Electronic Travel Authorisation such as India, China, Indonesia and Mexico. With convenient connections through Dubai from Emirates’ global network, travellers from Europe and other Northern Hemisphere markets can also trade winter’s colder days for Durban’s sunshine, beaches and festive-season atmosphere. Emirates has introduced a number of flexible booking policies to account for last-minute changes to travel plans, such as unlimited free date changes across all cabins on tickets booked to Dubai, and one free date change to anywhere else on the network. Customers can use Hold My Fare to lock in the ticket price for 24 hours, at no extra fee, while they finalise plans. The airline is also offering significantly reduced refund fees. For extra reassurance, travellers from South Africa and 26 other countries can add Emirates' Comprehensive Travel Cover when booking on emirates.com or later through Manage Your Booking. The insurance includes unlimited worldwide medical expenses, emergency evacuation, and cover for trip cancellation and baggage delay or loss. It also provides conflict cover, with medical expenses reimbursed up to US$25,000 and a free trip extension of up to 30 days, and it isn't restricted by government travel advice. Tickets are available now on emirates.com or the Emirates app, via travel agents or through online travel agents.
